items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: Now Purple Rose I think it was, I'm not positive but I think it was more Pierron than Steele.

ctx.x: I think he told me he wrote the music and Pierron wrote the words.
Yeah. Well Pierron was more of a lyric writer you see. Now Purple Rose I think it was, I'm not positive but I think it was more Pierron than Steele.
